query:
UPDATE documents AS d
        SET
            body_text = agg.body,
            content_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(agg.body, 'UTF8')), 'hex'),
            completeness = $2,
            completeness_reason = $3
        FROM (
            SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(text, E'\n\n' ORDER BY post_number), '') AS body
            FROM posts
            WHERE document_id = $1
        ) AS agg
        WHERE d.id = $1
